name: Daisy
summary: Our favorite cow on the whole farm! Daisy is a wonderful mother and a great milk cow, with lovely udder conformation.

photo.alt: Daisy, a red brindle cow, standing in tall grass and wildflowers

name: Ginger
summary: A great cow and our best milk cow on the farm, with great udder conformation. Sired by DD's MacIntosh (ADCA #024621).

photo.alt: Ginger, a black cow, grazing on pasture

name: Licorice
summary: A great brood cow and mother on the farm.

photo.alt: Licorice, a black Lowline Angus cow, standing in a pasture

name: Pumpkin
summary: A beautifully small mini cow out of Clove, by Jewel's Little General via AI. Her first calf, a bull by Branch, arrived in January 2021.

photo.alt: Pumpkin, a small red cow, standing in tall grass under a cloudy sky

name: Primrose
summary: A lovely cow out of Thyme, by South House Just My Luck via AI. She will be sticking around!

photo.alt: Primrose, a white cow with black speckles, in the barn with her calf

name: Sassafras
summary: One of the younger milk cows on our farm, and a sweet one. Out of Ginger, by our bull Quince.

photo.alt: Sassafras, a red brindle cow, with a mouthful of grass

name: Peanut
summary: Another youngster in the milking line-up. Out of Daisy, by our bull Quince.

photo.alt: Peanut, a shaggy red brindle cow, lying in a grassy field

name: Fern
summary: Our second-smallest cow, super friendly, and a great brood cow and mother. By Quince, out of our Lowline cow Licorice.

photo.alt: Fern, a small black cow, standing in a fenced pasture

name: Lavendar
summary: One of our smallest cows, and a sweet little milk cow. Out of Sage, by Buckwheat.

photo.alt: Lavendar, a white cow with black speckles, standing in a pasture

name: Maple
summary: Out of Violet, by Jewel's Little General via AI.

photo.alt: Maple as a young red calf, lying in hay in the barn

name: Birch
summary: Out of Sweet Pea and Dill.

photo.alt: Two young calves, one red and one white, resting together in the hay

name: Paprika
summary: Sired by FF Freedom's Red Cedar (ADCA #029788).

photo.alt: Paprika, a red Dexter bull, lying in the grass under an apple tree

name: Ash
summary: Out of our cow Licorice and bull Chili Pepper.

photo.alt: Ash, a young black bull with a collar, standing in a fall pasture

name: Dill
summary: Sire to some of our 2017 calves.

photo.alt: Dill, a white bull with black speckles, grazing

name: Chili Pepper
summary: Sire to our 2016 calves.

photo.alt: Chili Pepper, a dun Dexter bull, grazing in a pasture

name: Zoomer
summary: Sire to Jasmine and our 2015 calves.

photo.alt: Zoomer, a white bull with black speckles and dark ears, lying down

name: Matilda
summary: A wonderful sow we picked up in Ohio. She is robustly built and has very consistent litters: six so far, of 7 to 11 piglets each.

photo.alt: Matilda, a large black sow with white markings, grazing on green grass

name: Maisel
summary: A super sweet sow we got as an adult from Vermont. She has a very relaxed demeanor, is a great mother, and has had very consistent litters for us.

photo.alt: Maisel, a black and white sow, standing in hay

name: Gertie
summary: From White Bison Farm in Wisconsin, to add another line to our farm. She farrowed her first litter in the fall of 2021.

photo.alt: Gertie, a black pig with a red ear tag, getting a scratch behind the ears

name: Gladys
summary: Also from White Bison Farm in Wisconsin. Her first litter, in the fall of 2021, was 10 piglets.

photo.alt: Close-up of Gladys, a black and white pig with a pink ear tag, in the barn

name: Pumba
summary: A fantastically built boar from Mouse Creek Farm in Pennsylvania, with a nice wide face and a short, upturned nose. He has sired some wonderful litters on the farm.

photo.alt: Pumba, a black boar with white markings, standing on grass

name: Stilwell
summary: A young ginger boar we brought to the farm from New York. The first litters he sired were born in the fall of 2021.

photo.alt: Stilwell, a pale ginger boar, standing by a tree in the woods
